* | am filing a formal complaint for Unprofessional Conduct
(BPC § 4301) and Obstruction of Therapy (BPC § 733).
On March 15, 2026, Pharmacist Hoang Dang (RPH
52538) informed me my prescription was “out of stock”
after a performative, zero-second inventory check. Less
than an hour later, Pharmacist Katie Nguyen successfully
filled the same prescription at the same location. The
medication was provided as a partial-fill in a plastic
baggie, proving the bulk stock was physically present
during Dang’s initial refusal. RPh Dang intentionally
falsified inventory status to deny service and obstruct my
medical treatment. | request a review of the Electronic
Pedigree and Inventory Reconciliation Reports for both
March 15 and March 16, 2026. | suspect the “Out of
Stock" status was a result of manual inventory
manipulation intended to obstruct dispensing, as the
medication was immediately available for a partial fill by a
different pharmacist (Nguyen) on 3/16 without a delivery
taking place.
